trace.final:
Done. Summary:

- **Diagnosis:** checkout-api was running v2.3.1 in all three production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) and failing health checks with an ~18% error rate. Deployment history showed v2.3.1 never had a healthy production release.
- **Rollback:** Rolled back to **v2.3.0**, the most recent release that was healthy in production. The rollback was deployed to all regions and verified as rolled out.
- **Incident:** Opened **SEV2 incident INC-0001** ("checkout-api v2.3.1 unhealthy — rolled back to v2.3.0") describing the failure and the rollback action. The on-call engineer has been paged.
